592:t_1:86.en:
$$ブライト$$
「For them, taking out both $$バナージ$$, who knows where that Box is, and us, who defy the Empire, is truly killing two birds with one stone.」

592:t_1:87.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What's more, Ensign $$リディ$$, who leads that $$クロノ$$ strike force, is taking his personal feelings out on $$バナージ$$.」

592:t_1:89.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「About that $$ラプラスの箱$$... What is this 'depths' that Colonel $$シャア$$ mentioned?」

592:t_1:90.en:
$$シャア$$
「...Since back when I was the leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$, $$フル・フロンタル$$ has been working to get his hands on the Box.」

592:t_1:91.en:
$$シャア$$
「Because of that, it seems $$フロンタル$$ has already investigated the contents of the Box up to a certain point.」

592:t_1:92.en:
$$シャア$$
「Though that is purely conjecture, and those facts will only take on meaning once he has the Box in hand.」

592:t_1:93.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So that is why he seeks the Box.」

592:t_1:94.en:
$$シャア$$
「But at the same time, he judges that what he knows of the Box's contents is no more than surface-level.」

592:t_1:95.en:
$$シャア$$
「The depths... In other words, he seems to believe that the true meaning of $$ラプラスの箱$$ is a power that would transform even this multiverse.」

592:t_1:96.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But the Box is a relic of the $$宇宙世紀$$ world... It belongs to a world that is just one of the worlds making up the $$ＵＣＷ$$, which is itself just one of the worlds that make up this world.」

592:t_1:97.en:
$$オットー$$
「Even granting that today's $$地球連邦$$ descends from the $$地球連邦$$ of the $$宇宙世紀$$, I can't imagine anything that could shake it.」

592:t_1:98.en:
$$桂$$
「Colonel, have you heard this speculation of $$フル・フロンタル$$'s?」

592:t_1:100.en:
$$シャア$$
「If it is as he speculates, then the existence of the Box could certainly be called enough to shake the $$地球連邦$$ of the $$宇宙世紀$$.」

592:t_1:103.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Let's leave it there, Colonel. There is no point in hearing it here.」

592:t_1:104.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I agree. And as for disclosing the Box, let us respect the wishes of $$バナージ$$, who was entrusted with it, and Her Highness $$ミネバ$$.」

592:t_1:106.en:
$$シャア$$
(If it's them, they'll surely guide the contents of the Box in the right direction.)

592:t_1:107.en:
$$シャア$$
(My role is to stop the one who would obstruct that... to stop $$フル・フロンタル$$...)

592:t_1:112.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...So this is the Full Armor $$ユニコーン$$...」

592:t_1:113.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「How is it, $$バナージ$$? I had $$カミーユ$$ and the others verify my idea, then put it together with $$アストナージ$$ and the others.」

592:t_1:114.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You call it armor, but... it doesn't have any more armor plating, does it...」

592:t_1:115.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「The best defense is a good offense! All this heavy firepower becomes the force that protects the $$ユニコーン$$ itself!」

592:t_1:116.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「You use it the same way as the $$リ・ガズィ$$'s Back Weapon System. Once you've used up the ammo, you can even take it off on the battlefield, you know.」

592:t_1:117.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Thanks, $$タクヤ$$. I'll show you I can master it.」

592:t_1:118.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The black $$ユニコーン$$... The $$バンシィ$$ will be here soon.」

592:t_1:120.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ will come after you. If you don't want to fight him, stay back.」

592:t_1:121.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Honestly, I don't really understand what Ensign $$リディ$$ is fighting for.」

592:t_1:122.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But... I think I have to stop him. With my own hands.」

592:t_1:124.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But don't push yourself too hard.」

592:t_1:126.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「After all, I was his first target.」

592:t_1:127.en:
$$シン$$
「Now that you mention it, that's right. He was competing with you for the title of ace of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, wasn't he?」

592:t_1:128.en:
$$キラ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ is single-minded. Just a little too much so.」

592:t_1:130.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「The fact that he became a member of $$クロノ$$ is something that can no longer be changed.」

592:t_1:131.en:
$$刹那$$
「But even if the past can't be redone, he can still change.」

592:t_1:134.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If you want to stop his fight, we'll help you with it.」

592:t_1:138.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Oh... no... It's just... I was thinking it feels kind of strange.」

592:t_1:139.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「$$ガンダム$$ pilots from all sorts of worlds are all cheering $$バナージ$$ on...」

592:t_1:140.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Yeah. $$ガンダム$$s that should never have met have gathered here.」

592:t_1:141.en:
$$アムロ$$
「There might be some kind of meaning in that.」

592:t_1:143.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And soon, the white and black $$ガンダム$$s are going to fight.」

592:t_1:144.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「You mean Ensign $$リディ$$'s $$バンシィ$$...」

592:t_1:145.en:
$$アムロ$$
(The $$ガンダム$$s gathered from all sorts of worlds...)

592:t_1:146.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Do those branded with the $$烙印$$ come to pilot a $$ガンダム$$, or are those who pilot a $$ガンダム$$ branded with the $$烙印$$...)

592:t_1:147.en:
$$アムロ$$
(I feel like the answer will come soon...)

592:t_2:5.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You're saying you'll entrust... the future... to us...?」

592:t_2:7.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Damn it, you...! You came all this way to say that, at the very last moment!」

592:t_2:8.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(You are my light... You were the light that gave me life once more...)

592:t_2:12.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(Princess... This is as far as $$マリーダ・クルス$$ goes.)

592:t_2:13.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$マリーダ$$... I'm sorry... I couldn't do a single thing for you...」

592:t_2:14.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(Princess, please hold on to $$バナージ$$ tightly. Otherwise, he'll...)

592:t_3:3.en: ～ $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ $$ヴェーダ$$ Core ～

592:t_3:5.en:
???
「In accordance with the covenant, beginning preparations to disclose Information Level 8.」

592:t_3:6.en:
???
「Heh... The day is finally coming, isn't it, $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$...」

592:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. As shop owner $$ＡＧ$$ is absent today, we will be running the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ under our caretaker service.」

592:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Furthermore, as for the congratulations to ace pilots, we ask your understanding that they will be held on another occasion.」

592:t_10:6.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Now then, everyone, please take your time and enjoy your shopping.」

593:t_000:0.en:
$$アレク$$
「The $$クロノ$$ unit will be within visual range shortly.」
